blocks.text: Genesis 26 describes Isaac’s sojourn in Gerar during famine, Jehovah’s promise to him, and Isaac’s fear leading him to call Rebekah his sister. After Abimelech discovers the truth, Isaac prospers and disputes arise over wells. Isaac moves and eventually finds room at Rehoboth, receives Jehovah’s appearance at Beersheba, and makes a covenant with Abimelech. The chapter ends by naming Esau’s Hittite wives as a grief to Isaac and Rebekah.
